issuer: Suraksha General Health Insurance, Claims & Reinstatement Cell, Chennai
summary: Your health insurance policy has lapsed because payment was not made in time, meaning you currently have no hospital cover. You have until September 10, 2025 to pay Rs. 19,350 and revive it.

actions.task: Pay overdue premium plus revival penalty (Rs. 19,350) and submit Good Health Declaration Form
actions.why_it_matters: Restore health coverage and protect accumulated no-claim bonuses and waiting period credits

documents_needed: Duly signed Good Health Declaration Form (Form GH-4)
Recent medical prescription or discharge summary if hospitalized in the last 12 months
if_ignored: Policy will be terminated permanently and all continuity benefits and accumulated bonuses will be irrevocably lost.
